role: ours token-level source-attribution extractor; formal baselines untouched

data.native: Frozen native QA fit634 plus calibration159 replay plans.
data.expanded: Optional same-schema extra fit replay layouts; scoring is not enabled in v4.
data.official_test: No official-test or withheld-data path occurs in this runner.

coordinates.source: Every frozen rendered source-sentence span is re-intersected with original full-string tokenizer offsets; nonspace and alphanumeric coverage are asserted.
coordinates.answer: Every lexical answer BPE is owned exactly once by a frozen claim and retains local plus absolute coordinates.
coordinates.query: Post-token query at the original answer-token position; causal mask is rebuilt explicitly.
coordinates.previous_answer: Only original answer positions strictly smaller than q; q itself is excluded.
coordinates.other: All pre-answer positions outside the exact source-sentence union.

primitive: float32 softmax attention(q,k) multiplied by the corresponding repeated V-head L2 norm

aggregation.fragment: Maximum over fragment key tokens independently per head, unchanged from semantic-source-attribution v1.
aggregation.query: No claim/query averaging. Every lexical query BPE is an output row.
aggregation.heads: Arithmetic mean across all heads after fragment aggregation.
aggregation.region_share: Per layer normalize head-mean source, strict-previous-answer, and other-context relevance to sum one.
aggregation.sentence: Per token/layer source-sentence relevance normalized across source sentences before float16 storage; an exact zero-source-mass row remains all zero.

raw_outputs.token_sentence_share: float16 [lexical_BPE,32,source_sentences_in_answer], each row sums one or is exactly zero
raw_outputs.coordinates: query local/absolute position, token id, unique claim id, exact sentence identity
raw_outputs.forbidden: No full attention matrix and no token x sentence x head cache.

downstream_contract.token_features: Per layer: source/previous/other share, all-sentence attention-weighted frozen NLI E/N/C, top1 and top3 sentence concentration.
downstream_contract.window_supervision: Unchanged eligible 4-raw-BPE stride-one windows are the training rows; no claim-score projection.
downstream_contract.optional_score_inputs: Frozen generation NLL and independently fit-only upstream probabilities may be appended only in the scorer; scorer v4 excludes historically calibration-selected Lookback/large columns.
downstream_contract.split: Source-group OOF on fit; freeze model and thresholds before one calibration evaluation; official test sealed.

load_config.padding: one unpadded sequence and explicit all-ones mask; generation_config is not used

stage_gate: prepare -> cpu-check -> explicit extract -> status; no training or labels in this runner
